title: Tools for generating animated sprites.
author: Epoyato
selftext:
I've been experimenting with different tools to generate animated sprites. I used the [spritesheets.ai](http://spritesheets.ai) website. Here's the animation I got:

  
Does anyone know of any other tools?

comments.author: Southern_Charge5794
comments.body: Generate with any image-to-video models, like Kling O3, add start and end frame the same and write what you want. You get video file that can you convert into sprite sheets
